rotation: Same three sessions fixed to Mon / Wed / Fri so load progression stays readable week to week.
note: Week of 09-14 went 1 of 3. Wednesday is 2 for 2. Monday has never been logged once in two weeks and Friday is 1 of 2, so Monday drops to three lifts, roughly twenty minutes, and that is a floor rather than a target. Trunk and anti-lordosis work moved to Wednesday and add-in P so Monday has nothing left to negotiate with. Barbell RDL is demoted to a substitution after 09-16 put the load into the low back. Straight sets again, no supersets.

progression.rule: Double progression driven by the average RPE of the logged sets, matching the suggester already running in workout.html.
table: avg RPE 7.0 or below: add one load_step from assets/exercises.js.
avg RPE 7.1 to 8.0: hold the load and add a rep, unless every set was already at the same load and at the top of the prescribed rep range, which earns the load step instead.
avg RPE 8.1 to 9.0: repeat the same load and clean up execution.
avg RPE above 9.0: hold, or back off five percent.
Bodyweight and timed work progresses on reps or seconds, never load.
Dumbbell loads are per hand, so one load_step of 5 is one size up on one bell.
Any of the above is overridden when the session note reports pain or a form breakdown. Load does not advance on a pattern he cannot yet brace.
progression.note: workout.html does not know the rep-range ceiling, so its on-page suggestion can read 'chase a rep' where the program names a heavier load. The program's named load wins. LOGGING-SPEC.md still has no progression section; this field is the working record until it does.

sessions.title: Quads & Press
sessions.focus: Knee-dominant lower body, one horizontal press, one vertical pull. Three lifts, about twenty minutes. Monday has not been logged once in two weeks, so length is the only variable left to cut.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: No history on this one yet, so pick a load you can finish ten clean reps with and write the number down. Stop before your hips curl off the pad.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Start at 30 per hand, which is where your incline press sits. Per hand, not the pair.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Standard wide bar, not the rotating-handle machine. 100 for 10 across on 09-09, so hold 100 and chase 12 before the load moves.

sessions.title: Hinge & Overhead
sessions.focus: Loaded hip extension, vertical pressing, horizontal pulling, and the anti-lordosis brace. The day that actually happens, so it carries the most work.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cue: Hinge slot goes back to this after the RDL loaded your low back. Stop at a straight line from knee to shoulder, ribs down.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell press
exercises.cue: 30 per hand again. Last week was 10, 10, then a drop to 25. Three clean sets at 30 is the whole job this week.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Never logged yet. Torso stays still, pull with the back, and record the load.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Two sessions parked at 35 for 10. Stay at 35 and get 12 on all three sets, then it moves to 40.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Easier to keep a flat back than the dead bug was. Hips square, slow beats far.

sessions.title: Single-leg & Back
sessions.focus: One leg at a time for hip stability, incline pressing, and rear-shoulder work to balance the week's pressing volume.

exercises.name: Walking lunge
exercises.cue: 30 per hand on all three sets this time. Last time set one was 20, so the load step has not been earned yet.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.cue: 30 per hand for 10 across at Hard earns the step. Go to 35 per hand, bench at 30 degrees.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
exercises.cue: One arm at a time, single handle. Let the shoulder blade travel forward, then pull. The load has never been recorded, so record it.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.cue: Takes the rear-delt slot from the face pull. Elbows soft, light enough that nothing leans back.

optional_addins.title: Hips & Posture
optional_addins.focus: Direct work on the lordosis: lengthen the hip flexors, get the glutes doing their job, brace without arching. The dead bug fell apart on 09-16, and this is why.
optional_addins.when: Any off day. 12 minutes. The one that actually moves the lordosis.

exercises.name: Couch stretch
exercises.cue: Squeeze the back glute to tuck the pelvis. That tuck is the stretch.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.cue: Stop at a straight line. Do not arch past it.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.cue: Fewer reps than last time on purpose. If the low back lifts, keep your heels sliding on the floor instead of hovering.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.cue: Hips square, slow beats far.

optional_addins.title: Arms, Shoulders & Calves
optional_addins.focus: Low-stakes volume for arms, side delts and calves. Nothing here taxes recovery, so skip it guilt-free.
optional_addins.when: Saturday flex day. 20 minutes if you have the energy, skip it if you do not.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.cue: Elbows at your sides. No swinging from the hips.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.cue: Neutral grip the whole way. Hits the brachialis.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.cue: Moved off Friday to keep that day short. Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top, and record the load.
